known_limitations.description: HTTP URI and method heuristics are not e2e-verified and require visible HTTP metadata. T1110 and T1071 are existing coarse category mappings for credentials-in-URL and risky methods, not proof of brute force or C2.
Unit/state test sources (not golden-PCAP evidence): services/http-detector/test_http_detect.py, services/http-detector/test_http_state.py
Measured quality is computed by services/feedback-service/quality.py (KTD2); static confidence weights are not measured precision or false-positive rates.
